name: v1-agent-watcher
description: Delegate routine supervision of Codex V1 child agents to a cheap watchdog and inspect exact post-hoc rollout token usage.

interface.longDescription: Screens persisted V1 child-agent rollouts for observable loops and stalls, runs a persistent Luna watchdog that supervises and corrects the worker directly so the expensive parent stays dormant until a compact structured completion handoff arrives, and reports exact-thread post-hoc token accounting for benchmarks.
defaultPrompt: Supervise my running V1 worker with a Luna watchdog that handles routine correction itself.
